name: Amina
face: Young Congolese girl with warm brown skin, a round face, dark brown eyes, and a bright smile.
clothing: Tall wrapped headscarf in yellow with red and blue fan shapes, a yellow knee-length dress with the same red and blue fan print, short sleeves, and brown sandals.
proportions: Natural child proportions, about eight years old, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Short dark curls at the hairline beneath a tall yellow headwrap patterned with red and blue fan shapes, and a matching fan-print dress.
